description: PALARIS, the Office of the Palau Automated Land and Resources Information System, is the national geospatial office of the Republic of Palau. The government page read on 2026-09-28 describes it as the provider of GIS mapping services and the data hub for all geospatial data of Palau, links to a site to explore its data, and gives telephone, fax and e-mail contacts. Coverage is the islands of Palau. Access is free to explore; the licence, the formats and the content of the data hub are not stated on the page read, and custom maps are provided as a service. Caveats: the data site was not opened, so layer lists, dates and download options are unknown; Pacific island datasets are often compiled from projects with differing accuracy. It supports reference layers such as land parcels, roads, buildings and coastlines for hazard exposure studies of Palau's infrastructure under typhoons and sea level rise. No related Palau record is catalogued; the SPREP Palau Environment Data Portal (listed for the laptop pass) complements it.
